CS Console Guide

How to read the CS dashboard, register a CS, and keep it up to date.

Every screen is the real CS Console, captured with example data.1Numbers match the notes below each screen.

PART 1

Viewing the dashboard

Switch between Tickets and Monthly report with the tabs at the top. Tickets opens with every CS that is not done, grouped by the month it was received.

1.1Whole screen

1.2Language

1.3Action cards

Cards always count all open CS. Click one to filter the list, click it again to clear.

1.4View · period · sort

1.5List rows

1.6Monthly report

Open it with the Monthly report tab at the top. The chosen month’s key issues, notes and bars sit in one row (two rows on a narrower screen), with the monthly received · resolved chart at the bottom.

1.7Details

Click a row to open the details drawer. Most changes are saved right here.

1.8Open in popup

Show a CS in a floating window to compare several side by side.

1.9Translations

CS written in Korean appear in English. Right: the same CS after Show original.

Language is judged per field and per history line: an English history line on a Korean CS shows as written in English and only that line is translated on the Korean screen (and the other way round). Translations are made by Claude and saved. Customer, ticket IDs, names and versions are not translated. The edit form always shows the original.

PART 2

Registering a CS

Open the form with + New CS in the top bar.

2.1The form

2.2Fill in from a Slack message

Paste the message, click Analyze and fill in, then check the fields listed in the yellow line.

PART 3

Managing CS

3.1In the details

Change status, status note, CS owner, severity and history directly in the details drawer. See 1.7.

3.2Edit all · delete

Edit all in the details opens the full form with the current values.

3.3Reorder or insert history

3.4Manage owners

Open it with Manage owners under By owner in the monthly report. The list is shared by the team.
